title: Share bookmark, format v1
description: The `bookmark` sub-object of a SHARE_BOOKMARK node's sealed `node-meta` (ADR 0120 decision 3). The node-meta envelope (`{ v, ... }`, the `node-meta` field seal under the bookmark's K_node, bound to (scope, node), contracts/crypto/vectors/v1.json) is core's and carries this object under the key `bookmark`; nothing of it is in the clear. A member writes it once, when the bookmark is created; no guest ever reads or writes it (a link of an enclosing folder does not serve the node). `pad` makes the sealed envelope's length a multiple of 512 characters before sealing, so its size says nothing of the link's host or of a password. Readers ignore unknown fields. A bookmark whose meta carries no readable `bookmark` object, or a `link` that is no share link, opens nothing: the client says so and offers only its removal.

v.description: The format version of this sub-object (ADR 0079 decision 7).

link.description: The share link, normalized when it was pasted: its origin, `/s/<shareId>` and the fragment `#k=<base64url K_share>` and nothing else (no query, no other fragment parameter). `http` only for a loopback or `*.localhost` host.

password.description: The share's password as the member received it, where they gave one (ADR 0037: an access gate, never a key). Absent: none given.

pad.description: Spaces that round the sealed envelope up (see the description).
